description: This file is a C header file defining prototypes for functions related to the Sys Repository Record Object within a BroadWay Runtime System environment. It declares functions for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing repository record objects.

methods.name: SysCreateRepositoryRecord
methods.description: Creates a new repository record object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SysRroCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Sys Repository Record Object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SysRroRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified repository record object.

methods.name: SysRroEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects into the repository record object.
